name: Kotlin
description: Code intelligence for Kotlin projects with JetBrains kotlin-lsp.
about: In Gode’s editor, you can complete code, see errors and warnings as you type, inspect hover information, go to definitions, find references and rename symbols in Kotlin files. The language server starts when a Kotlin file opens in a project and stops when none are open. It includes its own Java runtime, so you do not need to install Java to start the server.
